+"""Reusable record preparation steps."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Any
+
+from _pytest.compat import is_async_function
+
+
+def _validate(record: object) -> tuple[str, Any, bool]:
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    return key.strip(), record["value"], enabled
+
+
+def prepare_with(record: object, display: Callable[[Any], Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate record and return a new prepared dict using display(value)."""
+    key, value, enabled = _validate(record)
+    return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": display(value), "enabled": enabled}
+
+
+def display_async(value: object) -> bool:
+    return is_async_function(value)
+
+
+def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return prepare_with(record, display_async)

@@ -34,3 +34,18 @@ def display_async(value: object) -> bool:
 
 def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
     return prepare_with(record, display_async)
+
+
+def batch(records: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare each record in order; duplicate trimmed keys raise ValueError."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        if item["key"] in seen:
+            raise ValueError("duplicate key: " + item["key"])
+        seen.add(item["key"])
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

     return prepared
+
+
+def group(records: object) -> dict[str, list[Any]]:
+    """Group display values of enabled records by first key character."""
+    grouped: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            grouped.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return grouped

+def merge(left: object, right: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare both lists; right records replace left ones with the same key."""

+        merged[item["key"]] = item
